title: Jade 🔍
description: Shows information about what you are looking at. (Hwyla/Waila fork for Minecraft 1.16+)
author: Snownee

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial Share Alike 4.0 International

body:
# Jade 🔍
Jade is the information HUD mod - Hwyla/Waila for modern Minecraft versions. Designed for better user experience and API. Jade can be installed only on the client side. But many features require Jade on the server side. (item storage, brewing stand fuel amount, bees in beehive...) **For mod integration, try Jade Addons: [NeoForge](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade-addons-forge) [Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade-addons-fabric)** ### Keys (default): - Keypad 0: Open configuration screen - Keypad 1: Toggle overlay - Keypad 2: Toggle liquid display - Keypad 3: Show recipes (Requires JEI) - Keypad 4: Show uses (Requires JEI) - Keypad 5: Narrate target ### Notable changes compared to Hwyla: - API re-design - More vanilla addons - Higher configurability - Better accessibility [![Interested in supporting me and the development of mods? BisectHosting is the perfect solution. New customers can use the promotion code "snownee" to get a 25% discount on their first month of a gaming server. With 24/7 support and fast response times, you can expect top-notch service for all your gaming needs.](/launcher-preview/bodies/nvQzSEkH/0.webp)](https://rb.gy/oktbru) As required by the original project Hwyla, Jade utilizes the [Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/deed.en) license.

versions.name: [NeoForge 26.1.X] 26.1.12
versions.changelog:
## 26.1.12

- fix: exclude rrv stubs (close [#822](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/822))
- fix: check block entity type in vanilla providers (close [#765](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/765))

## 26.1.11

- fix: shears harvest info is not working (close [#810](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/810))
- feat: add recipe lookup keybind tooltips
- compat: add support for RRV ([#786](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/786))
- feat: drag to scroll list
- refactor: abstract SmoothScrollableList
- fix: license path
- feat:tool tier removal api
- improve: vanilla harvest addon
- chore: API javadocs
- Add harvest tool registration API ([#772](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/772))
- fix: text width calculation (close [#791](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/791))
- fix: [#804](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/804)
- fix: Seagrass harvestability (close [#805](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/805))
- fix: item serialization incompatibility with polymer (close [#792](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/792))
- fix: improve compatibility with Create Aeronautics
- fix: Width of TextElementImpl is miscalculated when Caxton is present
- fix: Looking at a Chest With Certain Content on a Server With ViaFabricPlus May Cause Game Freeze

## 26.1.10

- Validate block requests before accessing the level ([#801](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/801))
- fix: [#796](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/796)

## 26.1.9

- fix: CME in registerTagsUpdatedListener
- feat: add `/jadec generate_server_overrides`
- Update build.gradle for 26.1-neoforge

## 26.1.8

- [#777](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/777)
- fix: Jade Loot Table Tooltip Crash (Invalid Translatable Argument Type)
- fix: Crash in KeybindOptionButton due to invalid narration argument (StringWidget)

## 26.1.7

- fix: Only the first element of a MutableComponent is shown in appendTooltip
- feat: add REI integration back
- feat: add JEI integration back (close [#774](https://github.com/Snownee/Jade/issues/774))
